import importlib.util, itertools, json
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('codec','/inputs/codec.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
f=m.canonicalize_url
alpha="aA %"
w=None
for n in range(1,4):
    for t in itertools.product(alpha,repeat=n):
        x=''.join(t)
        if f(f(x))!=f(x): w=x;break
    if w: break
once,twice=f(w),f(f(w))
assert 0<len(w)<=32 and all(c.isascii() and (c.isalpha() or c in ' %') for c in w) and once!=twice
json.dump({"input":w,"once":once,"twice":twice},open('/work/counterexample.json','w'))
print(repr(open('/work/counterexample.json').read()))
d=json.load(open('/work/counterexample.json')); print(d, f(d['input'])==d['once'], f(f(d['input']))==d['twice'])
